table.retrieve:
SELECT
	GroupName = CASE WHEN CashierActivity.ModuleID <= 11 THEN 'SALES' WHEN CashierActivity.ModuleID <= 32 THEN 'SALES RETURN' ELSE 'TRANSACTION VOUCHERS' END,
	Date=CashierActivity.Date,   
	PostDate = CASE WHEN CashierActivity.ModuleID <= 11 THEN  (SELECT MAX(S.PostDate) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode=CashierActivity.DocCode) WHEN CashierActivity.ModuleID <= 32 THEN (SELECT MAX(S.PostDate) FROM SRLedger S WHERE S.SRInvCode=CashierActivity.DocCode) ELSE NULL END,
	ModuleID=CashierActivity.ModuleID,   
	Module = (SELECT M.Name FROM Module M WHERE M.Module = CashierActivity.ModuleID),
	DocCode=CashierActivity.DocCode,   
	CatCode=CashierActivity.CatCode,   
	Category=CashierActivity.Category,   
	AccCode=CashierActivity.AccCode,   
	AccountName = Accounts.Name,
	MachineName=CashierActivity.MachineName,   
	HeaderNo=CashierActivity.HeaderNo,   
	HeaderInvNo=LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(CashierActivity.HeaderNo AS VARCHAR(10)))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(CashierActivity.HeaderInvNo AS VARCHAR(10)))),
	Amount=CashierActivity.Amount,   
	CashAccCode=CashierActivity.CashAccCode,   
	CashTendered=CashierActivity.CashTendered,   
	CashCharged=CashierActivity.CashCharged,   
	CashBack=CashierActivity.CashBack,   
	Remarks=CashierActivity.Remarks,   
	Active = CashierJob.Active,
	InActiveDate = CashierJob.InActiveDate,
	CashierJobCode=CashierActivity.CashierJobCode,   
	CashierName=Users.UserName,
	GLVochCode=CashierActivity.GLVochCode
FROM 
	CashierActivity, CashierJob, Users, Accounts
WHERE 
	CashierJob.CashierJobCode = :ai_code AND
	CashierJob.CashierJobCode = CashierActivity.CashierJobCode AND
	CashierActivity.AccCode = Accounts.AccCode AND
	CashierJob.JobOwner = Users.UserCode
ORDER BY Date
table.sort: groupname A, category A, date A
